GDPR scanning

GDPR document scanner

In short: A GDPR-compliant (DSGVO) document scanner keeps your documents under your control: processed on your device by default, hosted in the EU when a server is involved, without hidden third-party trackers or fonts, and with a data-processing agreement (AVV) available. Scandora keeps your documents off our servers by default, uses EU hosting (Hetzner, in Germany) for the few server-side steps, loads no third-party fonts or ad trackers, and runs on managed AI.

How Scandora is built for it

  • Your documents stay yours. Your original scans stay on your device and go only directly to Google Gemini for extraction — using a short-lived credential our server issues — and to the cloud services you choose. So your history syncs across your devices, we store a low-resolution preview and the extracted text on our EU servers — never your original files.
  • EU hosting. The few server-side steps run on Hetzner infrastructure in Germany.
  • No third-party trackers. The website loads the Inter font from its own server rather than a font CDN and uses self-hosted, privacy-respecting analytics rather than an ad tracker.
  • Managed AI. Extraction runs on Scandora's managed AI — no key to set up.

Which part of a scan sits on which server — path by path, sub-processors included — is set out on the document scanner on EU servers page.

FAQ

Is Scandora a GDPR-compliant document scanner?

Scandora is designed for DSGVO/GoBD record-keeping: your original scans stay on your device and in the storage you choose (only a low-resolution preview and the extracted text sync to our servers), EU hosting (Hetzner in Germany) is used for the few server-side steps, and no third-party fonts or ad trackers are loaded. GDPR compliance of your overall process also depends on how you store and retain documents.

Where are my documents stored?

By default on your device. Scandora does not store your original files or page images on its servers — scans go to the cloud services you choose and, for extraction, directly from your device to Google Gemini using a short-lived credential our server issues; when you are signed in, a low-resolution preview and the extracted text sync to our EU servers so your history is available on every device.

Does Scandora send my data to third-party trackers?

The Scandora website loads the Inter font from its own server rather than a font CDN and uses self-hosted, privacy-respecting analytics rather than an ad tracker, so visitor data is not sent to third-party ad networks.

Can I sign a data-processing agreement (AVV / DPA)?

Yes. An AVV / DPA is available for business customers.
